You are one of several READ-ONLY audit agents for the Nxeon customer-portal redesign (Phase 1 = audit only). Codebase: /opt/nxeon (Next.js 15 App Router, Prisma/Postgres, Stripe, separate worker/ process). Customer portal = app/dashboard/** + components/customer/**; API under app/api/**; logic in lib/**; schema in prisma/schema.prisma. Products: VPS, Shared Hosting, Game Servers, Domains (name.com registrar), Business Email (Mailcow), plus Volumes, free Minecraft, Kodely/AI builder credits.

HARD RULES: STRICTLY READ-ONLY. Do NOT edit/create/delete ANY file under /opt/nxeon, /opt/nxeon-staging or /opt/nxeon-sandbox. No build, npm, prisma, db, git-write, or service commands. Do NOT touch the live database, Stripe, name.com, or infrastructure. Do not read .env* files. Your ONLY write is your report file: /tmp/claude-0/-root/1716c7ee-ae35-4cf5-b557-9059709e07c4/scratchpad/audit-07-funnels.md (Write tool). Exhaustive, factual, cite repo-relative file paths, use tables, mark uncertain items UNVERIFIED.

EFFICIENCY: batch independent shell calls; use grep/sed ranges over whole-file reads for the big wizard components; a deploy hub component (components/customer/DeployHub.tsx) and per-product wizards are the core of this audit.

NOTE: the domains + business-email funnels have ALREADY been audited in detail elsewhere; cover them only at the level needed for your cross-product comparison tables (steps, payment mechanism, pre- vs post-payment fields) and spend your effort on VPS, Shared Hosting, Game Servers.

YOUR AUDIT: PURCHASE + DEPLOYMENT FUNNELS, end-to-end, per product. This is the most business-critical audit. The owner wants to evaluate a two-stage model: (1) a short conversion-focused checkout that only asks for config that affects price/capacity/region/availability/eligibility/provisioning, with intelligent defaults for everything else; (2) an optional post-payment setup (OS/image, apps, hostname, SSH keys, security, WordPress, game settings) that users may skip if safely changeable later. You must gather the FACTS needed to judge that per product; do not design.
For EACH product (VPS, Shared Hosting, Game Servers, then briefly Domains, Business Email, Volumes, free-MC, AI credits, add-ons):
1. ENTRY POINTS: every route/CTA that starts the flow (marketing pricing pages, /order/*, /dashboard/deploy, product list empty states, upsells, Kodely partner flow), and whether logged-out users can start (guest checkout? signup mid-flow?).
2. STEP MAP: exact ordered steps, the component file for each, every field per step (name, type, default, validation, required?), price-affecting fields, and the URL/state mechanism (query params, local state, localStorage draft, DB draft/order record). Note auto-advance behaviour, back navigation and whether state is preserved, and what happens on page refresh or on leaving the wizard (draft saved?).
3. REQUIRED-BEFORE-PAYMENT vs POST-PAYMENT MATRIX: for every config field, classify: affects price / affects capacity / affects region-availability / affects eligibility / needed by provisioner at create time / purely cosmetic-or-changeable-later. For 'changeable later' cite the existing API route that changes it after provisioning (this determines whether it can move to a post-payment setup step WITHOUT backend changes). Flag fields that the provisioner needs at create time and that have no post-provision change API (these cannot move post-payment without backend work — backend must not change, so they must stay pre-payment or get a safe default).
4. CHECKOUT + PAYMENT: how payment is taken (Stripe Checkout Session redirect? Payment Element embedded? saved card charge? wallet/credits?), where billing details are collected, promo code handling (COMEBACK50, first-month-free HOSTING-ONLY, riddle $100 credit, referral codes), currency (display vs charge), tax/VAT, the order/subscription records created and their status enums, webhooks and what they trigger, idempotency, what the user sees while waiting for webhook, payment-failure path (does config survive? where does the user land?), 3DS handling, the deploy-abandonment win-back email trigger conditions (timer), analytics events fired per step.
5. POST-PAYMENT: exact redirect/landing after success per product, what provisioning status the client can see (endpoint, polling interval, SSE), the real state machine (list every status value and which worker step sets it), whether there is any 'setup' step today, and the first-value moment (SSH creds shown? game IP shown? site URL? DNS instructions?). What emails are sent at each stage.
6. RENEWALS / UPGRADES / ADD-ONS purchase paths (upgrade plan, add backups, add IP, add mailbox, renew domain, transfer domain in) — where and how they charge.
7. FRICTION LIST per product: concrete friction points with evidence (e.g. fields asked too early, no defaults, unclear price, hidden renewal price, no progress preserved, spinner-only waiting, dead ends, ambiguous CTA labels, terminology), and dead/broken/half-wired steps.
8. A consolidated 'funnel facts' table: product | steps today | fields today | fields that truly must be pre-payment | fields that can move post-payment with existing APIs | payment mechanism | provisioning states available | time-to-ready if known.
Finish by writing the report, then reply with a ~15-line summary including that consolidated table.

# Audit 07 — Purchase + Deployment Funnels (READ-ONLY, Phase 1)

Codebase: `/opt/nxeon` @ 2026-09-03. All paths repo-relative. Facts only; no design proposals.
Anything I could not verify from source is marked **UNVERIFIED** (I did not touch the DB, Stripe,
name.com or any service).

---

## 0. Architecture in one paragraph

All four "deploy" products live behind ONE route, `app/dashboard/deploy/page.tsx`, which is a server
component that fetches everything for all four wizards and hands them to
`components/customer/DeployHub.tsx`. The hub is a tab strip (`?product=vps|hosting|game|email`,
`router.replace`, no navigation) that mounts exactly one wizard at a time:

| product | wizard component | server action entry |
|---|---|---|
| VPS | `components/customer/DeployWizard.tsx` (1913 L) | `payAndDeploy` (`lib/actions.ts:513`) |
| Shared Hosting | `components/customer/HostingDeployWizard.tsx` (1044 L) | `placeHostingOrder` (`lib/actions-hosting.ts:453`) |
| Game Servers | `components/customer/GameDeployWizard.tsx` (1659 L) | `payAndDeployGame` (`lib/actions-gameplans.ts:201`) |
| Business Email | `components/customer/EmailHosting.tsx` (1440 L) | `orderEmailHosting` (`lib/actions-email-hosting.ts:256`) |

Domains have their own routes (`/dashboard/domains/register`, `/dashboard/domains/transfer`) and are
NOT in the hub. `app/dashboard/order/page.tsx` is a bare `redirect("/dashboard/deploy")`.

Payment is uniform: an embedded `components/customer/PaymentStep.tsx` mounting a **Stripe Custom
Checkout session** (`ui_mode: "elements"`), plus PayPal and Coinbase rails that are only wired for
VPS. Everything settles through the single idempotent bus `lib/fulfil-checkout.ts`.

---

## 1. ENTRY POINTS

### 1.1 Every route/CTA that starts a purchase flow

| Entry | File | Target | Carries product? | Carries plan? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Portal nav "Deploy" | `app/dashboard/layout.tsx:40` | `/dashboard/deploy` | no (defaults to `vps`) | no |
| Dashboard home CTA ×2 | `app/dashboard/page.tsx` | `/dashboard/deploy` | no | no |
| Servers list + empty state | `app/dashboard/servers/page.tsx` | `/dashboard/deploy` | no | no |
| Games list + empty state | `app/dashboard/games/page.tsx` | `/dashboard/deploy?product=game` | yes | no |
| Hosting list + empty state | `app/dashboard/hosting/page.tsx`, `components/customer/HostingClient.tsx` | `/dashboard/deploy?product=hosting` | yes | no |
| Billing page ×2 | `app/dashboard/billing/page.tsx` | `/dashboard/deploy` | no | no |
| SSL page cross-sell | `components/customer/SslCertificates.tsx` | `/dashboard/deploy` | no | no |
| Claude Code hub ×2 | `components/customer/claude-code/ClaudeCodeHub.tsx` | `/dashboard/deploy` | no | no |
| Onboarding checklist | `lib/actions-onboarding.ts:57` | `/dashboard/deploy` | no | no |
| Marketing game configurator | `components/marketing/showcase/GameConfigurator.tsx:33` | `/dashboard/deploy?product=game` | yes | no |
| KB / chat-agent deep links | `lib/kb-plans.ts:45-48` | `?product=hosting|vps|game|email` | yes | no |
| Kodely partner SSO | `app/api/partner/checkout/route.ts:36,42` | `/dashboard/deploy?product=vps&ref=kodely` / `product=hosting&ref=kodely` | yes | no |
| Email templates | `lib/email-templates.ts:48` | `/dashboard/deploy` | no | no |
| Deploy win-back email | `worker/deploy-winback.ts` | deploy URL + `COMEBACK50` code | no | no |
| Marketing pricing cards | `components/marketing/PricingGrid.tsx`, `components/marketing/ProductPricing.tsx` | **`/register`** (bare) | **no** | **no** |
| Domains | `/dashboard/domains/register?...`, `/dashboard/domains/transfer` | n/a | n/a | domain carried via `initialDomain` |

### 1.2 Guest checkout / signup mid-flow

- **No guest checkout anywhere.** Every wizard route is under `/dashboard/**` and every action calls
  `requireUser()` first. `app/dashboard/deploy/page.tsx:37` starts with `await requireUser()`.
- **Marketing → purchase loses everything.** 38 marketing CTAs resolve to a bare `href="/register"`
  (`components/marketing/PricingGrid.tsx`, `components/marketing/ProductPricing.tsx`, etc.). The
  register page supports `?next=` (`app/register/page.tsx:27`, validated by `safeNext`), and
  `register()` honours it (`lib/actions.ts` ~line 320), but **no marketing CTA sets `next`** — only
  `components/AuthForms.tsx:260` (login→register handoff) does. So a visitor who clicks "Buy Starter"
  on `/pricing` signs up and lands on `/dashboard?signup=1`, not on the deploy wizard with Starter
  selected. Plan/product/term choice is discarded at the signup boundary.
- `?ref=` is captured into cookies at both ends: `ReferralCapture` (register page, `nxeon_ref`, 30d)
  and `PartnerSourceCapture` (every dashboard page, `nx_partner_ref`, 24h,
  `KNOWN_PARTNERS = ["kodely"]`).
- **Email-verification purchase gate** (`lib/email-verification.ts:123` `emailVerificationError`) is
  consulted by `payAndDeploy`, `payAndDeployGame`, `placeHostingOrder`, `orderEmailHosting`,
  `purchaseDomain`, `resizeServer`, `purchaseDedicatedIp`, `renewNow`. It **ships OFF** —
  `getSettingBool("email_verification_enforced", false)` — and additionally stands down if
  `mailConfigured()` is false. UNVERIFIED whether prod has flipped it on.
- `assertNotImpersonating()` blocks every spend path while an admin impersonates.

---

## 2. STEP MAPS

### 2.1 VPS — `DeployWizard.tsx`

Steps (`DeployWizard.tsx:320`): `["Plan", (Location if nodes>1), "Install", "Add-ons", "Access", "Review"]`
→ **5 steps today** (single node) or 6.

| # | Step | Fields | Type / default | Validation | Price-affecting |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Plan | `planId` | card grid; default `defaultPlanId` (`default_plan_slug` setting) else `plans[0]` | must exist | **YES** |
| 1 | Plan | `termMonths` | `TermLadder`, default `defaultTermMonths` (`default_term`) else 1 | must be in `VPS_TERMS` | **YES** |
| 1 | Plan | custom-plan builder (cpu/ram/disk sliders) | opt-in disclosure; floor = current Max plan | server `quoteCustomPlanAction` capacity check debounced 450 ms; `confirmCustomPlanAction` mints an inactive Plan row | **YES** |
| 2 | Location | `nodeId` | card grid, default `nodes[0]` | node must be enabled | no (capacity/availability) |
| 3 | Install | `imageId` | 4 tabs (OS / Control Panels / Applications / Games) + search + `VersionPickerModal`; default = first `PLAIN_OS` | `planMeetsImage` (`plan.ramMB >= image.minRamMB && plan.diskGB >= image.minDiskGB`) | no (gates plan eligibility) |
| 4 | Add-ons | `addons.malware`, `addons.backup`, `addons.docker` | 3 free toggles, all default **false** | none | no ($0) |
| 4 | Add-ons → "Advanced options (optional)" `<details>` | `dedicatedIp` bool (default false); `extraDiskGB` slider 0–`EXTRA_DISK_MAX_ADD_GB` step `EXTRA_DISK_STEP_GB` (default 0, one-way); `backupTier` FREE\|PLUS (default FREE) | | `effectiveDiskGB <= EXTRA_DISK_MAX_TOTAL_GB` | **YES** (all three) |
| 5 | Access | `hostname` | text, **auto-prefilled** `<imageFamily>-<rand4>` (`defaultHostnameFor`), `hostnameTouchedRef` stops overwrite after first keystroke | `/^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$/i` and length 3–40 (client says 3–40, `hostnameValid` only enforces `>= 3`; server `orderSchema` enforces 3–40) | no |
| 5 | Access | root password | **not a field** — generated server-side, honest copy only (`DeployWizard.tsx:1383-1395`) | — | — |
| 5 | Access → "Advanced (optional)" `<details>` | `pubKey` textarea | default "" | server-side regex `^(ssh-(rsa\|ed25519)\|ecdsa-sha2-\S+)\s+\S+` before persisting | no |
| 5 | Access | `free` checkbox | **admin only** | — | yes (admin grant) |
| 6 | Review | `couponInput` → `couponApplied` | server-verified via `previewOrderCoupon` | server `couponOrderDiscountCents` | **YES** |
| 6 | Review | `useWallet` | default ON when `balanceCents > 0` | — | yes (split only) |

- **State mechanism:** all React `useState`. Every selection is mirrored into hidden inputs on a
  single `<form action={payAndDeploy}>` (`DeployWizard.tsx:857-871`).
- **Draft:** `sessionStorage` key `nxeon.deploy.draft.v1` written on every change
  (`DeployWizard.tsx:468-479`). It is **only read back when the URL carries `?canceled=1`**, then
  deleted. A plain page refresh, tab close, or navigating away and back **loses everything** — the
  wizard remounts at step 0 with defaults. There is no DB draft/order record.
- **Auto-advance:** none on VPS. Every step needs an explicit Continue.
- **Back navigation:** `← Back` (or `PaymentStep`'s own Back) decrements `step`; state is preserved
  because the component never unmounts.
- **Two hard-won safety guards** documented in-file: distinct React `key`s on the Continue/Deploy
  buttons and an `onSubmit` guard that refuses submission unless `isLast` — a prior incident had
  "Continue" on the Access step placing five real orders (`DeployWizard.tsx:827-855`).
- **Reassurance copy** on every non-Review step: "You're a few clicks from live… We've picked
  sensible defaults — change anything you like, or just keep clicking Continue."
- **Sticky cart** (`WizardStickyCart`) follows every step with plan name + `/mo` incl. add-ons, and
  duplicates the Continue/Deploy handler. Suppressed once `PaymentStep` mounts.
- **Blockers** are surfaced in words on the step that can fix them (`primaryBlocker`,
  `installBlocker`, `accessBlocker`, `deployBlocker`) and wired via `aria-describedby`.

### 2.2 Shared Hosting — `HostingDeployWizard.tsx`

Steps (`:126`): `["Plan", "Domain", (Install if apps.length>0), "Add-ons", "Review"]` → **5 steps**.

| # | Step | Fields | Default | Validation | Price-affecting |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Plan | `planId` | `plans[0]` | active plan | **YES** |
| 1 | Plan | `termMonths` (TermLadder) | **`ANNUAL_TERM_MONTHS` (12)** — annual pre-selected | in `PRODUCT_TERMS` | **YES** |
| 2 | Domain | `domainMode` "temp"\|"own" | `"temp"` (badged "Recommended") | — | no |
| 2 | Domain | `subLabel` (temp mode, optional) | "" → server derives `<username>.<base>` | debounced 400 ms `checkHostingSubdomain`; blocks Continue if typed-but-unavailable | no |
| 2 | Domain | `domain` (own mode) | "" | `/^([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z]{2,}$/` | no |
| 3 | Install | `appSlug` | `""` ("None for now") | must be in `apps` | no |
| 4 | Add-ons | `extraDiskGB` −/+ stepper | 0 | 0…`EXTRA_DISK_MAX_ADD_GB` | **YES** |
| 5 | Review | `useWallet` | ON if balance > 0 | — | split only |
| 5 | Review | renewal-method gate (`addCard`) | — | `savedCard \|\| balance >= renewalCents \|\| cardCents > 0` | — |

- **No promo-code field on hosting.** (VPS, and only VPS, has one.)
- **Draft:** `sessionStorage` key `nxeon.hosting.deploy.draft.v1`, written **only** by `saveDraft()`
  which is called **only from `addCard()`** (`:299,311`). Restored only when the URL carries
  `?card_setup=<sid>` (`:246-297`), which also finalises the saved card via `finalizeCardSetup` and
  jumps to Review. So: unlike VPS there is no continuous draft write — abandoning at any point other
  than the card-setup round-trip loses everything, and there is no `?canceled=1` restore path at all.
- **Idempotency:** one client token per mount (`idemRef`, `crypto.randomUUID()`), sent as
  `idempotencyKey`; server claims `FulfilledSession("hostorder:<key>")`.
- Two distinct Stripe primitives coexist: `StripeCheckoutModal` (mode `setup`, capture a renewal
  card, old `embedded_page` ui_mode) and `PaymentStep` (mode `payment`, Custom Checkout).

### 2.3 Game Servers — `GameDeployWizard.tsx`

Steps (`:286`): `["Game", "Plan", "Settings", "Review"]` → **4 steps**.

| # | Step | Fields | Default | Validation | Price-affecting |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Game | `game` (family) | `games[0].family` | family must have tiers | indirectly |
| 1 | Game | search / category pills / sort; grid capped at 12 with "Show all" | `gameSort="featured"` | — | no |
| 2 | Plan | `selected` (tier id) | **`null`** — nothing pre-selected | required | **YES** |
| 2 | Plan | `termMonths` | **12 (Annual)** | `PRODUCT_TERMS` | **YES** |
| 2 | Plan | custom-plan builder + "how many players?" slider (`recommendedSpecForPlayers`) | — | server capacity check | **YES** |
| 3 | Settings | `serverName` | "" (optional, max 60) | — | no |
| 3 | Settings | `hostname` | "" (optional, auto-generated server-side by `randSuffix`) | 3–40, `HOSTNAME_RE` when non-empty | no |
| 3 | Settings | `subdomain` (**Minecraft only, REQUIRED**) | "" | `validateSubdomainFormat` (3–20, not reserved) + uniqueness at insert | no |
| 3 | Settings → "Advanced options (optional)" | `dedicatedIp` | false | — | **YES** |
| 3 | Settings | `variant` (server type/loader) | `schema.defaultVariant` | `isValidVariant` | no |
| 3 | Settings | per-family `values` (`GAME_CONFIG_SCHEMAS`, 32 families) | schema defaults (`defaultValues`) | `validateConfig`; `required: true` fields (e.g. DST `TOKEN`) block checkout | no |
| 4 | Review | `useWallet` | ON if balance > 0 | — | split only |

- Per-family field counts: Minecraft 9, Rust 5, Palworld 5, CS2 4, Valheim 2 (`lib/game-config.ts`).
  Every field carries `phase: "deploy" \| "live"`; `"deploy"` is labelled "applied at deploy" in the
  wizard and "restart" in the post-purchase `GameSettings.tsx` — it is a *restart* marker, **not** an
  immutability marker.
- **No promo-code field** on game.
- **Auto-advance:** clicking a game tile calls `pickGame()` which **jumps straight to step 2**
  (`:509-520`) and resets tier/variant/values. This is the only auto-advance in any wizard.
- **Draft:** `sessionStorage` `nxeon.gamedeploy.draft.v1`, written continuously (`:566-575`),
  restored only on `?canceled=1` (`:523-563`), same one-shot pattern as VPS.

### 2.4 Business Email — `EmailHosting.tsx` (cross-comparison only)

`ORDER_STEPS = ["Domain", "Plan", "Review"]` (`:169`). Fields: `domain` (defaults to first ACTIVE
owned domain; free text otherwise → `isExternal` DNS path), `planId` (`plans[0]`), `termMonths`
(default 12), `useWallet`. No promo code. **No sessionStorage draft at all.**

### 2.5 Domains (cross-comparison only)

`DomainRegisterWizard.tsx`: `BASE_STEPS = ["Domain","Term","Contact"]` + optional `"Email"` (when
`freeInboxPlan` is seeded) + `"Review"` → **4–5 steps**. The Contact step is a full ICANN registrant
form (firstName, lastName, address1, city, stateProvince, postalCode, country, phone, email) with
optional Geoapify address autocomplete. `DomainTransferInWizard.tsx` is its own multi-step flow.
No sessionStorage draft in either.

---

## 3. REQUIRED-BEFORE-PAYMENT vs POST-PAYMENT MATRIX

Legend for **Class**: `PRICE` = changes the amount charged · `CAP` = capacity/oversell check ·
`AVAIL` = region/availability · `ELIG` = eligibility/promo · `CREATE` = the provisioner needs it at
VM/account creation · `LATER` = cosmetic or changeable after provisioning.

### 3.1 VPS

| Field | Class | Post-provision change API | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| `planId` | PRICE, CAP | `resizeServer` (`lib/actions-server.ts:160`) UP only; `resizeServerDown` (`lib/actions-server-lifecycle.ts:194`) with guards; both prorate | **must stay pre-payment** (it is the price) |
| `termMonths` | PRICE | none (only `renewNow` / `toggleAutoRenew`) | **must stay pre-payment** |
| `nodeId` (Location) | AVAIL, CAP | **none** — no VM-migration action exists | must stay pre-payment (only shown when >1 node) |

| `backupTier` (FREE/PLUS) | PRICE | `upgradeServerBackupTier` (`lib/actions-backup.ts:33`) via `BackupTierUpsell.tsx` | **could move post-payment** |
| `couponCode` | PRICE, ELIG | n/a | pre-payment by definition |
| `useWallet` | split only | n/a | pre-payment |

Grep for any `hostname:` write outside order placement found nothing. | **cannot move post-payment without backend work** — must stay pre-payment or take the existing auto-generated default |
| `sshPublicKey` | CREATE (worker reads `db.sshKey` for the user at clone time, `worker/index.ts:588`) | `addSshKey` (`lib/actions-account.ts:93`) adds to the **account**, but nothing re-injects into a live VM | **cannot move post-payment without backend work** (customer can add manually over SSH) |
| `addons.docker` | CREATE (cloud-init `curl … get.docker.com`, `worker/index.ts:251`) | **NONE** | **cannot move post-payment**; wizard copy "You can add or remove these later in your VPS dashboard" is **not true** for docker |
| `addons.malwareScanner` | CREATE (cloud-init ClamAV, `worker/index.ts:252`) | **NONE** | same as above |
| `addons.dailyBackup` | bridged at sale to `autoBackup`+`backupIntervalHours` (`lib/order.ts:922-926`) | `setBackupSchedule` (`lib/actions-server-lifecycle.ts:45`) | **can move post-payment** |
| `free` (admin) | ELIG | n/a | admin-only |

### 3.2 Shared Hosting

| Field | Class | Post-provision change API | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| `planId` | PRICE, CAP | `upgradeHostingPlan` (`lib/actions-hosting.ts:1309`) | pre-payment (it is the price) |
| `termMonths` | PRICE | none | pre-payment |
| `extraDiskGB` | PRICE (quota snapshot = `(plan.diskGB + extraDiskGB) × 1024`) | **NONE** — `AddStorage.tsx` calls `expandServerDisk`, which is VPS-only. No hosting analogue found. | **cannot move post-payment without backend work** |

## 4. CHECKOUT + PAYMENT

### 4.1 Mechanism

### 4.2 Pricing / promo / coupon / tax

- **Wizard-displayed price === charged price by construction.** Every wizard derives its numbers from
  the same pure modules the server charges from: `lib/renewal-quote.ts`, `lib/billing-terms.ts`
  (`termPriceCents`), `lib/wallet-split.ts`. Extensive in-file comments cite two real incidents
  (2026-07-26 "H1" wrong renewal figure, "H2" post-payment re-quote) that produced this discipline.
- **Sold price is frozen** in Stripe metadata as `OrderPrice` (`lib/order.ts:162`) /
  `GameOrderPrice`, and `placeOrder`/`placeGameOrder` bill off `sold ?? quote`, never a re-quote.
- **Terms**: `VPS_TERMS` = 1 / 3? / 12 / 24 / 36 months — 1 (0 %), 12 (`annual_discount_percent`,
  live admin setting), 24 (30 %), 36 (40 %). `PRODUCT_TERMS` is the same array.
- **first-month-free** — `firstMonthFreeAppliesTo("HOSTING")` only. `app/dashboard/deploy/page.tsx`
  deliberately gates the *VPS display* the same way `lib/order.ts` gates the *charge*, so the VPS
  wizard never shows "$0 first month". Eligibility is per-`userId` **and** per-`ipHash`
  (`firstMonthFreeEligible`). On the card path it is **RESERVED** before the Checkout session is
  created (`reserveFirstMonthFree`, `payAndDeploy:627-657`), CONFIRMED at fulfilment, RELEASED on
  `checkout.session.expired`, and swept as a backstop. A lost reserve re-quotes at full price and
  recomputes the split.
- **Coupons** (`COMEBACK50` etc.) — VPS only. `previewOrderCoupon` verifies server-side; the applied
  discount is **cleared whenever `planId`/`termMonths`/`dedicatedIp`/`extraDiskGB` changes**
  (`DeployWizard.tsx:710-713`). Same reserve→confirm→release protocol as the promo
  (`reserveOrderCoupon`), with guards for `firstTimeOnly`, `maxRedemptions`, one-per-account,
  one-per-IP.
- **Riddle $100** (`lib/riddle.ts`) is a **wallet credit** (`balanceCents` increment), so it flows
  through "Apply my balance", not through the coupon field.
- **Referral** (`nxeon_ref`) is attributed at signup, and `maybeRewardReferral(user.id)` fires after
  a paid `placeOrder` — it is not a checkout-time discount.
- **Currency**: display-only. `useCurrency()` + `convertAndFormat`; every posted value and every
  charge stays **USD cents**. The wizards print "Prices shown in {CUR} for reference — you're billed
  in USD ($X)".
- **Tax/VAT**: `taxContextForUser(user)` from the billing country; 0 for anyone with no billing
  country on file. Shown as a "VAT / Tax (X% · CC)" line and folded into `dueCents`; the rate + cents
  are stamped onto `OrderPrice` so fulfilment settles the same total. **Game and Hosting orders carry
  no tax at all** (`GameOrderPrice` is `{chargeCents}` only; `placeGameOrder` writes
  `taxCents: 0, taxRatePercent: 0`).

### 4.3 Records, statuses, webhooks, idempotency

| Record | Where | Status values |
|---|---|---|
| `Server` | `lib/order.ts:896` / `lib/game-order.ts:~400` | `PENDING, PROVISIONING, RUNNING, STOPPED, SUSPENDED, REINSTALLING, DELETING, ERROR` |
| `Job` | `tx.job.create({type:"PROVISION"})` in the same tx | `QUEUED, RUNNING, DONE, FAILED` |
| `HostingAccount` | `orderHostingAccountFor` | `PENDING, PROVISIONING, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, FAILED, DELETING` |
| `Invoice` | in-tx, `status: "PAID"`, itemised lines that sum to the debit | — |
| `WalletTransaction` | in-tx, negative amount | — |
| `FulfilledSession` | the one-winner idempotency primitive, `UNIQUE(stripeSessionId)` | `CLAIMED, DONE, FAILED` |
| `DeployFunnelEvent` | `/api/track/deploy-step` + server-side | `type: step \| error \| complete` |

- **Webhook**: `app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts` handles exactly two events —
  `checkout.session.completed` (→ `fulfilCheckoutSession`) and `checkout.session.expired` (→ release
  promo/coupon holds). The success redirect `app/api/stripe/confirm/route.ts` calls the *same*
  function; whichever arrives first wins the `FulfilledSession` claim, the other is a no-op. The
  route explicitly documents that a browser redirect must never be the fulfilment trigger.
- **Dispatch** (`lib/fulfil-checkout.ts` `runFulfilment`): `unpaid` → no-op; `unreadable` → claim +
  settle FAILED + notify; then `order` / `gameOrder` / `hostOrder` / `emailOrder` / `domainOrder` /
  `resize` / `diskExpand` / … branches. Card money is first credited to the wallet
  (`creditCheckoutSession`, `UNIQUE stripeSessionId`) and then debited back out by the placement
  function — so the wallet is never touched before the card clears.
- **Hosting idempotency** additionally uses a client `idempotencyKey` →
  `FulfilledSession("hostorder:<key>")`, shared by the wallet path and the card path.

### 4.4 What the user sees while waiting for the webhook

- Card confirm navigates the **top window** to `/api/stripe/confirm`, which runs fulfilment
  synchronously and 302s to the product page with `?purchase=1` (+ `pv`, `pc`, `pe`, `prod` for the
  pixel). So there is no "waiting for webhook" screen in the happy path — the redirect *is* the
  fulfilment.
- If `fulfilCheckoutSession` **throws**, the user lands on `/dashboard/billing?pending=1`.
  **`pending` is not read by `app/dashboard/billing/page.tsx`** (it destructures only
  `paid`, `canceled`, `card_setup`), so this is a **silent dead end** — the customer sees the billing
  page with no explanation.
- PayPal/Coinbase return to `/dashboard/deploy?paid=1` (`lib/actions-payment-providers.ts:393`) —
  and **`paid=1` is read by nothing on the deploy page** either. Same silent landing.

### 4.6 Deploy-abandonment win-back (`worker/deploy-winback.ts`)

- **Master kill-switch first line**: `DEPLOY_WINBACK_ENABLED === "true"` **or**
  `getSettingBool("deploy_winback_enabled", false)`. **Defaults OFF.** UNVERIFIED whether prod has it on.
- Trigger: users with any `DeployFunnelEvent{type:"step"}` whose **most recent** step is
  older than `deploy_winback_delay_minutes` (default **30 min**) and newer than
  `deploy_winback_max_age_days` (default **30 days**).
- Excludes: users who completed, already own a server, unverified/opted-out, or already received the
  `deploy_winback` template (deduped on `EmailLog.template`).
- Offer: `COMEBACK50`, `WINBACK_PERCENT_OFF = 50`, expiry label = last day of next month. The coupon
  itself is **not minted by this code** — the owner must create a matching coupon.
- Caps: `MAX_SENDS_PER_SWEEP = 25`, `SEND_GAP_MS = 1200`. Uses `product_news` NotifyKind so the

**Summary**

All four deploy products share one route (`app/dashboard/deploy/page.tsx` → `DeployHub.tsx`, tabbed on `?product=`), and one payment surface (`PaymentStep.tsx`, Stripe Custom Checkout embedded, settling through the idempotent `lib/fulfil-checkout.ts` bus). Pricing is provably display===charge: every wizard derives numbers from the same pure modules the server bills from, and the sold price is frozen into Stripe metadata.

The two-stage model is well supported on **Game** (nearly every Settings field is changeable via `saveGameConfig`, including `phase:"deploy"` ones — that flag means "restart", not "immutable"), partly on **Hosting** (domain and app install both have post-provision APIs; extra storage does not), and least on **VPS**, where four fields the provisioner consumes at clone time have **no post-provision change API at all**: `hostname` (`renameServer` only writes `label`), `sshPublicKey`, `addons.docker` and `addons.malwareScanner` (cloud-init one-shots). The Add-ons step's copy — "You can add or remove these later in your VPS dashboard" — is untrue for docker and malware.

Notable hard findings: marketing CTAs are 38 bare `href="/register"` links that discard the plan/product choice at signup; a page refresh mid-wizard loses everything (drafts are written but only read back on `?canceled=1`); `?paid=1` and `?pending=1` are written by six redirect sites and read by none, so paid-but-unfulfilled orders and all PayPal/Coinbase returns land silently; shared hosting sends **no email and no in-app notification** when an account goes ACTIVE; game orders charge **no VAT** while VPS does; and there is **no game tier upgrade or downgrade path** — `lib/resize.ts:97` refuses and points at a setting that doesn't exist.
